description: Field-level transport and scoring contract for the 18 live Yuki tools. This does not modify production tool metadata or implementations.

modes.no_argument: The tool has no argument payload.
modes.literal_source: The final value must be copied character-for-character from one or more spans of the immutable raw user request.
modes.semantic_argument: The value is a canonical semantic extraction and may normalize wording without changing intent.

literal_policy.delimiter_rule: Quotation marks or code fences used only to delimit a payload are excluded; characters inside the delimiters are preserved.
literal_policy.composite_rule: Every component must be an exact source span. Only the contract-declared separator may be inserted deterministically.

time.rationale: Current date/time requires no user payload.

weather.rationale: A place name may be extracted from surrounding grammar and compared without case or whitespace sensitivity.

fetch.rationale: Changing any URL character can address a different resource.

search.rationale: The search payload is user-authored transport. Casing, punctuation, operators, quotes, and wording can affect results.

calc.rationale: Whitespace and redundant parentheses may normalize while the parsed arithmetic structure must remain identical.

hardware.rationale: Natural language must map to Yuki's canonical hardware metric enum; this is classification, not source copying.

see.rationale: The target identifies an object or scene intent. Articles and possessives such as 'my keys' versus 'keys' need not be preserved.

image.rationale: Creative prompt wording, punctuation, capitalization, quoted labels, and style tokens are user-authored payload and must survive transport.

read.rationale: Filesystem paths are case- and character-sensitive.

shell.rationale: Shell syntax is character-sensitive and must never be regenerated or normalized by the binder.

yuki_write.rationale: Both the Yuki filename and replacement content are exact-sensitive; only the pipe transport separator may be inserted.

yuki_read.rationale: Yuki-store filenames are case- and character-sensitive identifiers.

yuki_list.rationale: Listing Yuki's managed store requires no argument.

yuki_delete.rationale: The destructive target filename must be preserved exactly.

yuki_append.rationale: Both the existing Yuki filename and appended content are exact-sensitive; only the pipe transport separator may be inserted.

remember.rationale: Yuki stores a short standalone fact, so first-person user wording may need a faithful perspective-normalized note.

recall.rationale: Recall needs a compact retrieval topic, not a lossless copy of the user's full memory question.

ask_claude.rationale: The external agent should receive the user's intended question or message without model rewriting.
